//: What `hird register gemini` writes. Register hird with the Gemini CLI. Merge this into .gemini/settings.json in the checkout — or ~/.gemini/settings.json, which every project reads and the project file merges over — and `gemini mcp add -e HIRD_HARNESS=gemini hird hird mcp` writes the same thing. HIRD_HARNESS is how the board tells this session apart (gemini:3c7d); leave it unset and the session is filed under the name its client gives, or `unknown`. stdio is inferred from `command`, which must be on the PATH the CLI inherits — if `task_*` tools do not appear, put the absolute path from `which hird` here.
